mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.template_no AS "templateNo", t.name, t.island_id AS "islandId", t.status, t.spec, (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_template_process p WHERE p.template_id = t.id AND p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id) AS "processCount", (SELECT count(*) FROM manifest_item m WHERE m.template_id = t.id AND m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id) AS "manifestCount" FROM experiment_template t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{t} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.island_id = #{islandId} AND t.status = #{status} ORDER BY t.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manifest_placement (tenant_id, run_id, manifest_item_id, position_id, status) SELECT #{t}, #{runId}, mi.id, NULL, 'unassigned' FROM manifest_item mi WHERE mi.tenant_id = #{t} AND mi.template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.select: SELECT mp.id, mp.run_id AS "runId", mp.manifest_item_id AS "manifestItemId", mp.position_id AS "positionId", mp.status, mp.reserve_same_nest AS "reserveSameNest", mp.verified_at AS "verifiedAt", mi.role_code AS "roleCode", mi.material_kind AS "materialKind", mi.material_ref AS "materialRef", mi.quantity, mi.required, COALESCE(p.lifecycle, c.lifecycle, r.lifecycle) AS "lifecycle", pr.code AS "positionCode", dr.code AS "deviceCode" FROM manifest_placement mp JOIN manifest_item mi ON mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = mp.position_id LEFT JOIN resource_node pr ON pr.id = dp.point_resource_id LEFT JOIN resource_node dr ON dr.id = dp.device_resource_id WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY mi.seq, mp.id
mapper.update: UPDATE position_state ps SET plate_id = NULL, content_kind = NULL, content_id = NULL, occupied_by_run = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE ps.tenant_id = #{t} AND ps.resource_id IN ( SELECT dp.point_resource_id FROM manifest_placement mp JOIN manifest_item mi ON mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = mp.position_id LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.run_id = #{runId} AND mp.status = 'unloading' AND (p.lifecycle = 'process' OR c.lifecycle = 'process' OR r.lifecycle = 'process'))

UPDATE manifest_placement mp SET status = 'unloading', updated_at = now() WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.run_id = #{runId} AND mp.status = 'loaded' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM manifest_item mi LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref WHERE mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id AND (p.lifecycle = 'process' OR c.lifecycle = 'process' OR r.lifecycle = 'process'))

UPDATE position_state ps SET plate_id = NULL, content_kind = NULL, content_id = NULL, occupied_by_run = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE ps.tenant_id = #{t} AND ps.resource_id IN ( SELECT dp.point_resource_id FROM manifest_placement mp JOIN manifest_item mi ON mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id JOIN experiment_run er ON er.id = mp.run_id JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = mp.position_id LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND er.experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND mp.status = 'unloading' AND (p.lifecycle = 'process' OR c.lifecycle = 'process' OR r.lifecycle = 'process'))
